proposed_capability: Moonwake /fifth-gear P95→P82→P08→P07→P124: community user clicks website download, opens a Windows bootstrap file, safely clones/fast-forwards canonical BetterInstincts checkout, installs existing offline toolkit, discovers installed Sims 4, and explicitly launches it with player-controlled existing-save or CAS path and advisory trait/aspiration guidance.
player_save_control_impact: Clone only repository into canonical path, offline user-scoped app install, no game file or save writes. Game detection is read-only and bounded to known installation roots or manually selected executable. Launch only on explicit user action; no automatic Resume click, save-slot selection, CAS input, OS input hooks or Windows settings changes. Player always retains game control.
expected_outcome: One downloadable Windows launcher file, user-facing download page, clone/install with safe existing-checkout update, GUI selection of found Sims 4 install, opt-in game launch, bounded existing-save or New Game/CAS handoff, advisory trait/aspiration goal suggestions; deterministic negative tests and CI; avoid promising live gameplay from offline checks.
negative_tests: Missing Python or Git fails informatively without installing or elevating system tools
Pre-existing foreign or dirty checkout is not overwritten
Repository URLs and clone targets are fixed, no arbitrary remote code fetched and executed
Missing or multiple game candidates block unapproved launch
Executable not TS4 in Game/Bin or a symlink cannot launch
No silent startup of Sims 4, no auto Resume, no save edits or automatic trait clicks
Single owned use path and existing installer manifest preserved
Portable discovery supports EA/Steam known locations and manual path
Fifth-Gear P08 Windows/live proof reported separately from CI
rollback_path: Revert isolated branch/PR; previous bootstrap.py install/uninstall and manifests untouched; no Sims data or OS changes by offline tests.
unresolved_unknowns: GitHub connector cannot inspect local user Windows game install, EA/Steam login or live save selection
No signed Windows installer or GitHub Pages publishing proof yet; cmd file may be warned by SmartScreen
Exact future Sims patch and real CAS/gameplay must be observed on disposable host under separate P08
